art_direction: 成年布尔玛穿白色工装外套，在薄荷色复古工作室坐着看小型星球模型。
composition_variation: Create a colorful retro-futurist anime portrait of adult Bulma at a tidy personal workshop. Preserve her recognizable turquoise bob, blue eyes, and self-assured friendly expression. Dress her in a fully covering white utility jacket, coral turtleneck, dark trousers, and low boots. She sits sideways on a mint stool with one hand gently adjusting a small decorative planet mobile on the table. Use rounded cream appliances, pale aqua panels, peach reflections, soft chrome accents, and a broad blank illuminated upper wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
